essence: At that moment, the mantra should be recited one hundred and eight times.
If the recitation is not done, the wandering power will go to the guru.
To protect his own power, the guru should then recite the mantra.
With an undivided mind, one should offer whatever is most desired in the world.
The desired outcome will come to be.
